# Additional alternating-ring inventory tables

All numbers use $K=c_f=1$. Each displayed number is the rounded midpoint of an outward-rounded interval; authoritative enclosures, exact binary endpoints, controls and root certificates are retained under `.local-data/ring-exploration/inventory-ladders/`. These 600 local zero brackets are not a proof of whole-cell uniqueness or completeness. See the [owning derivation](ring-inventory-ladders-2026-10-03.md).
